dialogues.speaker: Kanra
dialogues.text: You are too nice. Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Kanra
dialogues.text: Umm... You seem like a seasoned Traveler. I'll give this amulet to you, it'll protect you in your journeys ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Kanra
dialogues.text: If I can see my lover again, I'll prepare one for him as well...
